trigger: concurrent set() promoting a key to secret commits entirely between read_secret()'s two sequential un-transacted SELECTs
summary: read_secret() TOCTOU: two sequential SELECTs let a concurrent set() land between them, returning nullopt while a real secret existed. Independently found by unhappy-path, chaos-injector, enterprise-readiness. Fixed via single UNION ALL statement (matches get()/get_all()'s existing pattern); no lock needed.

trigger: wait_for_advisory_waiter() times out (the lock silently not taken) while a REQUIRE sits between thread spawn and join
summary: Both advisory-lock regression tests could std::terminate the whole shard on the exact regression they exist to catch. Independently found by cpp-safety, cpp-expert, quality-engineer. Fixed by deferring the wait-result assertion until after ROLLBACK+join; empirically fault-injection-verified by cpp-safety (mismatched lock key -> one clean red assertion, no abort).
